item.title: Hilarious healing: ‘In laughter yoga, we use the body to lead the mind’
item.description: On the fourth Sunday of every month Venerable Suco Hue Huong, the Buddhist nun who anchors Buu Hung Buddhist Monastery in east Vancouver, offers a no-nonsense lecture about life, death and the human quest for happiness to visiting spiritual seekers, whether they’re curious newcomers or regular students.

item.title: Protesters target Rep. Perez for voting record
item.description: Protesters have gathered in front of U.S. Rep. Marie Gluesenkamp Perez’s Vancouver offices every day this week.

item.title: Washougal School District asks voters to approve two renewal levies in Feb. 10 special election
item.description: The Washougal School District is asking voters to approve two renewal levies in Clark County’s Feb. 10 special election.

item.title: Feds greenlight $2 billion renewable project on Yakama Nation sacred site along Columbia
item.description: Federal energy regulators last Thursday greenlit a roughly $2 billion renewable energy megaproject on a Yakama Nation sacred site overlooking the Columbia River in Klickitat County.

item.title: Elena Rybakina wins Australian Open by beating No. 1 Aryna Sabalenka
item.description: MELBOURNE, Australia (AP) — Elena Rybakina finally won her second Grand Slam title with a victory over top-ranked Aryna Sabalenka at the Australian Open on Saturday, and it was something of a testament to quiet achievers.

item.title: As an uncertain 2026 begins, virtual journeys back to 2016 become a trend
